summary: David L. Smith, 57, of Fort Collins drowned after his raft capsized between mile markers 107 and 108 on Highway 14 in the Poudre Canyon; separated from his group, he was not wearing a helmet or flotation device
location: Cache la Poudre River, mile markers 107-108, Highway 14
responding_agency: Larimer County Sheriff's Office Emergency Services; Larimer County Dive Rescue Team; Larimer County Search and Rescue; Poudre Canyon Fire Protection District; Poudre Fire Authority
notes: Recorded at the incident/search date per convention. Multi-day search over ~12 miles of river (drone, helicopter, divers) called off June 30; a kayaker found the body ~2:40 p.m. July 23 near mile marker 112 (~4 mi downstream); identity confirmed by the Larimer County coroner's office. Smith's two companions (a 46 YOM and his 13-year-old son, the only one in a life jacket) made it to shore with minor injuries. run 791 merge: LCDRT VP's first-person account of the 2019-06-29 (Saturday) Mishawaka missing-rafter call (David L. Smith incident).
